title: SPEARHEAD SEP-PACT tool
description: SEP-PACT (Solar Energetic Particle Analysis and Calculation Tool) analyses Solar Energetic Particle (SEP) events automatically, with the data of the High Energy Telescope (HET) of Solar Orbiter's Energetic Particle Detector (EPD). For every event and energy channel group, it computes the onset time, the peak flux and its time, and the fluence of electrons and protons. It is developed within the SPEARHEAD (SPEcification, Analysis & Re-calibration of High Energy pArticle Data) project.
